method.scope: Public SEOasis Reddit philosophy and proposed transparent client workflow.
method.boundary: Public HTML sample reviewed; official Reddit policies checked live. No posts, outreach or automated engagement performed. No client threads or actual AI outputs verified.

sources.title: Reddit Rules
sources.note: Official rules inspected on October 14, 2026: Rules 2 and 5 address community rules, authentic participation and misleading identity. This supports the proposed participation guardrails, not channel performance.

sources.title: Spam — Reddit Help
sources.note: Official help page, updated October 6, 2026. Addresses mass engagement, repetitive content, spam-promoting tools, authenticity and moderator discretion. No universal contribution ratio is a safe harbor.

sources.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
sources.note: Live homepage: Shopify/ecommerce AEO positioning; team identities; collection, Reddit, foundation/monitoring pillars; quarterly recalibration and client reporting cadence. Outcome claims are company-reported.

findings.title: Reddit Authority Building is an explicit pillar
findings.evidence: The Reddit service page pairs community work with collection pages, schema and AI visibility monitoring.
findings.businessImplication: Treat community listening as part of the account strategy, with a named specialist and measurable hypotheses.

findings.title: SEOasis publishes an operating philosophy
findings.evidence: The public guide and strategy page discuss identifying relevant communities, understanding rules, helpful participation and query monitoring.
findings.businessImplication: Translate public philosophy into an account-specific, transparent workflow rather than assuming all communities permit promotion.

findings.title: Public claims do not establish model causality
findings.evidence: The service pages assert relationships between Reddit activity, AI recommendations and revenue, but client threads, repeated model outputs and attribution exports were not inspected.
findings.businessImplication: Preserve these as SEOasis marketing claims. This artifact makes no claim that a post enters a training set, that mentions cause recommendations, or that schema guarantees AI inclusion.

findings.title: Official Reddit guidance sets the participation boundary
findings.evidence: Reddit requires community-rule compliance and authentic identity, and prohibits spam and manipulation.
findings.businessImplication: Use transparent, useful participation and community-specific permissions; no disguised endorsement or coordinated voting.

findings.title: No client community output or performance is verified
findings.evidence: No approved client Reddit account, live thread inventory, referral export or saved AI test series was provided.
findings.businessImplication: No post count, upvote total, mention share, conversion rate or AI visibility percentage is reported.

opportunities.title: Build a listening map before choosing participation
opportunities.evidence: SEOasis publicly prioritizes subreddit research and community norms. No target-client community fit was verified.
opportunities.opportunity: Build a listening map before choosing participation
opportunities.action: For one approved client, record relevant questions, product/use-case language, current rules and whether the appropriate action is listen, answer or abstain.
opportunities.recommendedAction: For one approved client, record relevant questions, product/use-case language, current rules and whether the appropriate action is listen, answer or abstain.
acceptanceCriteria: Community rule URL and review date saved
Example public thread URLs saved without unnecessary personal data
Explicit listen-only status where promotion is restricted
No minimum size or posting quota assumed
opportunities.metric: Verified relevant questions and approved community fit
opportunities.notes: Proposed operating task; benefit and commercial outcome require validation.

opportunities.title: Document transparent participation and escalation
opportunities.evidence: Official Reddit rules support authentic participation; SEOasis guide discusses usefulness and includes an affiliated founder-response example.
opportunities.action: Write a concise response gate: relevant expertise, accurate product facts, clear affiliation, allowed format and human final review. Record removals and feedback; pause rather than evade a community decision.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Write a concise response gate: relevant expertise, accurate product facts, clear affiliation, allowed format and human final review. Record removals and feedback; pause rather than evade a community decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Disclose employee/agency/client affiliation in a relevant recommendation
No fake customers, bought accounts or votes
No mass comments, copied replies or automated engagement
No karma farming or ratio used to bypass moderation
opportunities.metric: Approved participation brief and useful accepted contributions; no volume target
opportunities.dependency: Approved identity, scope and current community rules
opportunities.notes: Proposed operating task; benefit and commercial outcome require validation.

opportunities.title: Separate referral, search and AI observation logs
opportunities.evidence: SEOasis describes weekly query monitoring, but saved client outputs and attribution evidence are unavailable.
opportunities.opportunity: Separate referral, search and AI observation logs
opportunities.action: Use three ledgers: permitted referral links/landing pages; branded GSC trend with confounders; repeated AI prompt outputs with exact cited URLs. Review each against the hypothesis without implying causality.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Use three ledgers: permitted referral links/landing pages; branded GSC trend with confounders; repeated AI prompt outputs with exact cited URLs. Review each against the hypothesis without implying causality.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt wording, model/surface, locale, date and saved output retained
Brand mention separated from citation and linked referral
Concurrent releases, promotions and seasonality logged
No training-ingestion claims or visibility percentage without a defined denominator
opportunities.metric: Referral outcomes; branded query movement; repeatable citation observations reported separately
opportunities.dependency: GA4/GSC access, approved prompt panel and human test operator
opportunities.notes: Proposed operating task; benefit and commercial outcome require validation.

opportunities.title: Turn community questions into useful collection briefs
opportunities.evidence: Public philosophy connects community questions to transactional collection pages. No client assortment or margin data was inspected.
opportunities.opportunity: Turn community questions into useful collection briefs
opportunities.action: Route repeated use-case questions to keyword/collection research. Validate distinct intent, product fit, stock, substantiated claims and margin before creating a page.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Route repeated use-case questions to keyword/collection research. Validate distinct intent, product fit, stock, substantiated claims and margin before creating a page.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing page match checked before expansion
Buyer criteria reflected in useful copy and internal links
No health or performance claim invented from a comment
opportunities.metric: Approved collection hypotheses; qualified collection outcomes require GSC/Shopify
opportunities.dependency: Catalog, inventory, margin, GSC query data and editorial QA
opportunities.notes: Proposed operating task; benefit and commercial outcome require validation.

rejectedClaims: No fabricated backlink counts, rankings, referral revenue or AI visibility rates.
No claim that a Reddit mention causes training ingestion, AI recommendations or incremental revenue.
No deceptive account, endorsement, voting, spam or engagement automation recommendation.
synthesisNotes: Confirm current link-building partner scope with Mike; public role and commercial positioning may have different account scopes.
Use community questions to inform collection hypotheses; validate catalog and buyer intent before page production.
Keep referral outcomes, branded search movement and AI citations as separate measurements.
